metadata.name: Glassy Coverflow Carousel
metadata.description: A responsive 3D coverflow carousel for poster galleries and media collections. Includes swipe and keyboard navigation, optional autoplay, light and dark themes, reduced-motion support, and an on-demand trailer dialog. Media and branding are supplied through props.
metadata.author: automate_flows
